fields.statement: QA at 5ad7b858 with the built binary in a scratch repo, live daemon (not --once), rhiza.web.port 17991: rhiza daemon set rhiza.web.host rejected localhost, abc, '' and 127.0.0.1:80 (exit 2, naming rhiza.web.host) and wrote nothing. Default bound 127.0.0.1:17991 only (ss; curl loopback 200, LAN 192.168.1.210 refused). While the daemon ran, set rhiza.web.host 0.0.0.0: the listener moved on a later poll to *:17991 and the UI served 200 over LAN and Tailscale IPs; POST to /, /api/call/change.new and /api/daemon.set from the LAN answered 405 only GET is allowed. Set 192.0.2.7 (not on the host): nothing listened, daemon stderr logged the bind error each poll. Set ::1: bound [::1]:17991 (200 on ::1, LAN refused). Port off: listener closed.

QA at 5ad7b858 with the built binary and a live daemon in a scratch repo on port 17991: rhiza daemon status showed Web UI: http://127.0.0.1:17991 at the default, http://0.0.0.0:17991 after rhiza daemon set rhiza.web.host 0.0.0.0 and a poll, http://[::1]:17991 (bracketed) after ::1, and Web UI: off after rhiza.web.port off. go test ./cmd/rhiza -run TestScripts/(daemon-settings|daemon-status|describe-golden) passed.
